remove bond_port ipv6_address: delete the IPv6 address of a bond port.
remove bond_port ipv4_route: delete the IPv4 route of a host bond port.
remove bond_port ipv6_route: delete the IPv6 route of a host bond port.
change bond_port ipv6_address: change the IPv6 address of the bond port.
change bond_port ipv4_address: change the IPv4 address of the bond port.
remove bond_port ipv4_address: delete the IPv4 address of a bond port.
add bond_port ipv4_route: add an IPv4 route to the bond port. You can run this command to add a route to connect the storage system to the application server when their IPv4 addresses are not at the same network segment.
add bond_port ipv6_route: add an IPv6 route to the bond port. You can run this command to add a route to connect the storage system to the application server when their IPv6 addresses are not at the same network segment.
delete ssh known_hosts: delete the server "known_hosts" file or a certain record in the file that is saved by the SSH client.
import ssh_host_key_file: replace the public key file and private key file on the SSH server.
delete user: delete a user or user group. You can delete the users that are no longer required for managing and maintaining the storage system by running this command.
change user: operate users, including resetting users' login passwords, changing user role IDs, forcing users offline, modifying a user's login method, modifying a user's authentication factors, and setting a specified user's password to never expire.
import weak_password_dictionary: import and overwrite a complete weak password dictionary.
import license: import license files. You can activate or update license files by running this command.
add smartqos_policy host: add hosts to a SmartQoS policy.
remove smartqos_policy file_system: remove file systems from a specific SmartQoS policy.
change disk erase: erase data on disks. Data can be erased from only non-member disks or faulty member disks in a disk domain.
change recycle_bin_policy: modify parameters related to the recycle bin policy.
delete recycle_bin_view: delete objects from the recycle bin view.
remove protect_group lun: remove a member LUN from a specified protected group.
change disk_domain rekey: manually update the AK according to the disk domain.
change disk_domain general: modify the properties of a disk domain, including the disk domain name, hot spare strategy, switch status of the LUN mapping table repair function, and similarity-based deduplication execution level.
add disk_domain disk: add disks to a disk domain.
change storage_pool general: modify the attributes of a storage pool, including the name, capacity alarm threshold, capacity exhaustion threshold, capacity, provisioning limit, low threshold of protection capacity, high threshold of protection capacity, and automatic deletion switch.
add storage_pool disk: add disks to a storage pool.
change lun_takeover finish_switch_path: confirm that the host paths of the specified LUN have been switched to the paths between the host and the target disk array.
change lun_takeover enhance_switch: set the enhanced masquerading switch of a specified LUN.
change lun_takeover disable_switch_path: forbid the specified LUN's paths to be switched back to the source array and to allow the LUN to be used as the source LUN for online takeover.
create lun_workload_type general: create a workload type for LUNs. After creating a workload type, you can choose it when you are creating LUNs. Through this method the LUN space parameter can be reasonably set.
remove lun_consistency_group lun: remove a member LUN from a specified LUN consistency group. Use this command when consistency protection is not required for a specified LUN.
remove lun_takeover general: delete the information about a takeover LUN.
change lun: modify LUN settings, including the name and capacity.
add host initiator: add an initiator to a host.
remove lun_group lun: remove LUNs from a specified LUN group.
remove host_group host: remove a specified host from a host group.
remove port_group port: remove a specified port from a port group.
add rep_port_group port: add ports to a replication port group.
add mapping_view port_group: add a port group to a mapping view.
remove mapping_view lun_group: remove a LUN group from a mapping view.
remove mapping_view port_group: remove a port group from a mapping view.
remove mapping_view host_group: remove a host group from a mapping view.
add mapping_view host_group: add a host group to a mapping view.
change mapping_view: change the host LUN IDs of the LUNs in mapping_view.
add mapping_view lun_group: add a LUN group to a mapping view.
add smartqos_policy hierarchical: add normal SmartQoS policies to a specified hierarchical SmartQoS policy.
add smartqos_policy lun: add logical unit numbers (LUNs) to a SmartQoS policy.
add smartqos_policy lun_group: add LUN groups to a SmartQoS policy.
remove smartqos_policy hierarchical: remove normal SmartQoS policies from a specified hierarchical SmartQoS policy.
remove smartqos_policy host: remove hosts from a specific SmartQoS policy.
remove smartqos_policy lun: remove LUNs from a specific SmartQoS policy.
remove smartqos_policy lun_group: remove LUN groups from a specific SmartQoS policy.
change smartqos_policy enabled: enable or disable a specified SmartQoS policy.
delete smartqos_policy: delete one or more specified SmartQoS policies.
add smartqos_policy file_system: add file systems to a SmartQoS policy.
show remote_replication available_file_s: query the information on available file system tasks.
add host nvme_over_roce_initiator: add an NVMe over RoCE initiator to a host.
change nvme_over_roce_initiator general: modify the attributes of an initiator, including its alias and NVMe qualified name (NQN), as well as replace an initiator.
remove host nvme_over_roce_initiator: remove an NVMe over RoCE initiator from a host.
delete nvme_over_roce_initiator general: delete an NVMe over RoCE initiator. After the deletion, the host can no longer access the storage system resources through the initiator.
change iscsi initiator_name: change the name of an iSCSI initiator configured for the storage system.
change iscsi initiator_name_v2: change the name of an iSCSI initiator configured for the storage system.
change smartqos_policy min_goal_reserved: modify the minimum performance of LUNs that have not been added to a lower limit guarantee policy.
delete quota general: delete a quota of a file system, or a quota of a specified dtree.
remove hyper_cdp_schedule fs: remove file systems from a HyperCDP schedule.
change file_system enabled: enable file system related functions, such as to enable checksum, to perform periodic snapshots, and to modify the Atime.
change file_system general: modify file system parameters such as the name, capacity, block size, and owning controller.
clear cifs connection: close the network connection of the specified client or server.
change service cifs: modify the settings of the CIFS share service.
create share_homedir_rule cifs: create a mapping rule for a Homedir share.
change share_homedir_rule cifs: modify the mapping rule of a Homedir share.
change share nfs: modify the configurations of an NFS share.
change smart_cache_pool switch: enable or disable a SmartCache pool.
remove smart_cache_partition lun: remove LUNs from a SmartCache partition.
remove smart_cache_partition file_system: remove file systems from a SmartCache partition.
change mapping host_lun_id: modify IDs of mapped host LUNs.
change container_service general: change the status of a container service.
change container_service active: activate the container service for the first time.
add fs_hyper_metro_domain quorum_server: add a quorum server to a HyperMetro domain.
remove fs_hyper_metro_domain quorum_serv: remove a quorum server from a HyperMetro domain.
change fs_hyper_metro_domain split: split a file system-based HyperMetro domain.
swap fs_hyper_metro_domain: perform a primary/secondary switchover for a HyperMetro domain cluster.
change fs_hyper_metro_domain second_fs_a: modify the access permission of the secondary end of a HyperMetro domain cluster.
change fs_hyper_metro_domain recover: recover a file system HyperMetro domain.
change fs_hyper_metro_domain local_logic: change the working status of all local logical ports in a HyperMetro domain cluster.
change hyper_copy restore: start, stop, pause, and resume full or differential reverse synchronization of the HyperCopy pair.
remove hyper_copy_consistency_group hype: remove HyperCopy pairs from a specified HyperCopy consistency group. Use this command if consistency management is not required for HyperCopy pairs.
change hyper_copy_consistency_group rest: set reverse synchronization parameters of a HyperCopy consistency group.
change hyper_copy_consistency_group sync: start, pause, continue, and stop member synchronization of a HyperCopy consistency group.
change clone restore: start, stop, pause, and resume full or differential reverse synchronization of the clone pair.
remove clone_consistency_group clone: remove clone pairs from a specified clone consistency group. Use this command if consistency management is not required for clone pairs.
change clone_consistency_group synchroni: start, pause, continue, and stop member synchronization of a clone consistency group.
change clone_consistency_group restore: set reverse synchronization parameters of a clone consistency group.
remove snapshot_consistency_group snapsh: remove snapshots from a specified snapshot consistency group.
test system trust: test whether the system can be trusted and show the test result to users.
change dr_star third_resource_access: change the read and write permissions of secondary LUNs in remote replication at the DR Star third site.
change rest msg_return_type: change the command output returning mode of REST interfaces to synchronous or asynchronous.
change devicemanager ciphersuite: configure the OpenSSL cipher suite used by the DeviceManager service.
change hyper_cdp_consistency_group resto: restore data using HyperCDP consistency groups. You can use the HyperCDP consistency groups to restore the source protection group data by running this command.
change hyper_cdp_consistency_group gener: modify the name and restoration speed of a HyperCDP consistency group.
change hyper_cdp_consistency_group cance: change hyper_cdp_consistency_group cancel_restore command is used to cancel the restoration of a HyperCDP consistency group.
change hyper_cdp general: modify the name and restoration speed of a HyperCDP object.
remove hyper_cdp_schedule lun: remove LUNs from a HyperCDP schedule.
change snapshot cancel_restore: cancel the rollback of a snapshot.
change snapshot capacity: modify the capacity of a snapshot.
change snapshot io_priority: change the I/O priority of the snapshot.
change snapshot restore: roll back snapshots. You can use the snapshots to restore the destination LUN data by running this command.
change snapshot speed: change the rollback speed of the snapshot.
remove hyper_cdp_schedule lun_consistenc: remove LUN consistency groups from a HyperCDP schedule.
remove hyper_cdp_schedule protect_group: remove protection groups from a HyperCDP schedule.
change snapshot reactivate: reactivate snapshots. Use this command if you want to set the point in time of a snapshot to the latest point in time of the source LUN or HyperCDP object.
create snapshot duplicate: create a duplicate for a snapshot or a HyperCDP object. You can back up a snapshot or a HyperCDP object by running this command.
create snapshot_consistency_group genera: create a snapshot consistency group for a specified LUN consistency group.
create snapshot_consistency_group univer: create a snapshot consistency group for a specified LUN protection group.
change hyper_cdp_schedule enabled: enable or disable a HyperCDP schedule.
create snapshot_consistency_group duplic: create a duplicate for a specified snapshot consistency group or HyperCDP consistency group.
change snapshot_consistency_group restor: start restoration from a snapshot consistency group.
change snapshot_consistency_group cancel: cancel restoration from a snapshot consistency group.
change snapshot_consistency_group genera: modify the properties of a snapshot consistency group.
create snapshot general: create snapshots. You can create an identical and usable point-in-time duplicate for a data object by running this command.
change remote_replication second_fs_acce: set the read and write attributes of a secondary file system.
change remote_replication general: modify a specified remote replication pair.
swap remote_replication: implement primary/secondary resource switchover of a remote replication. Use this command when you need to copy the data at the secondary resource to the primary resource using remote replication.
change remote_replication synchronize: synchronize a specific remote replication. Use this command when you need to synchronize the data at the primary resource to a secondary resource to ensure data consistency.
change remote_replication split: split a remote replication task. During the split of a remote replication task, then data synchronization stops between both resources.
create remote_replication general: create a LUN-based remote replication pair.
remove consistency_group remote_replicat: delete remote replication pairs from a consistency group.
add consistency_group remote_replication: add the remote replication into the consistency group after the initial synchronization of the remote replication is complete.
swap consistency_group: implement primary/secondary switchover for existing remote replication tasks in a consistency group.
create consistency_group synchronization: create a synchronous consistency group. You can centrally manage multiple synchronous remote replication pairs by running this command.
change consistency_group general: modify information about a consistency group.
create remote_device general: create remote devices. You must create a remote device by running this command before you can effortlessly perform remote replication tasks between the storage system and remote device.
change remote_device general: modify the name and link of remote devices.
change fs_snapshot restore: roll back a file system to a specified snapshot.
change fs_hyper_cdp restore: roll back a file system to a specified HyperCDP object.
delete fs_hyper_cdp general: delete a file system HyperCDP object.
add hyper_metro_domain quorum_server: add a quorum server to HyperMetro domains.
remove hyper_metro_domain quorum_server: remove a quorum server from HyperMetro domains.
change hyper_metro_consistency_group sta: forcibly start a HyperMetro consistency group.
remove hyper_metro_consistency_group pai: delete a pair from a HyperMetro consistency group.
change hyper_metro_consistency_group gen: change the information about a HyperMetro consistency group.
change quorum_server general: change the information about a third-place quorum server.
remove quorum_server_link general: remove a specified link between a storage array and a quorum server.
delete kmc general: delete the configuration of an external key management server.
delete domain nis: initialize the configuration of an NIS domain.
change domain ad_config: change the name, site, and machine account of the domain controller, determine whether to overwrite the existing machine account when the storage array joins the AD domain, as well as determine whether to join or exit the domain.
add security_rule: add a security rule to control the maintenance terminals that attempt to access the storage system.
change certificate auto_update: modify the automatic certificate update configuration.
import crl file: import a new certificate revocation list.
delete certificate general: delete CA certificate information from an array.
import certificate: import a new private key, certificate, and CA certificate.
delete ldap configuration: delete the configuration information on Lightweight Directory Application Protocol (LDAP) servers.
change alarm_level: change the severity of a specified alarm.
change alarm clear: clear alarms from the storage system.
export event: export logs, key logs, Call Home data, event information, diagnostic files, disk enclosure logs, FTDS statistics, or disk data destruction reports of a storage system.
show file export_path: export system data to a directory in the storage system and show the directory to users.
change operation_log: modify the retention policy of operation logs.
change iscsi target_name: change the name of the iSCSI target configured for the storage system.
change snmp usm: modify the configuration of a USM user.
change snmp safe_strategy: change the security policy of the SNMP service.
change snmp port: set the port number of the SNMP service.
change snmp version: set the status of the SNMPv1 and SNMPv2c protocols and the switch status of the SNMP unique controller enclosure ID function.
remove ntp_server general: delete an NTP server used for time synchronization.
change system dns_load_balance: enable or disable the DNS load balancing function and configure the load balancing policy.
change system server_port: modify port information of the system.
change nas_service active: activate the NAS feature service for the first time.
add ntp_server general: add an NTP server for time synchronization.
reboot system: restart the storage system. Running this command causes service interruption.
poweroff system: power off the storage system. Running this command causes service interruption.
change system time: change the storage system's time. If the storage system's time is incorrect, you can run this command to change it.
change system timezone: change the time zone where the storage system resides in. If the displayed time zone is different from the actual local time zone, you can run this command to change the time zone.
change system ntp: configure the NTP. Run this command if you want the storage system to synchronize its time with that of an NTP server.
change ntp_server config: configure the time synchronization function. Run this command if you want the storage system to synchronize its time with that of an NTP server.
change dns_zone general: modify the name a DNS zone.
change controller service_session: change the service duration of a controller.
change controller starting_point_date: change the service start time of a controller.
poweroff interface_module: power off a specific interface module.
change bond_port general: change the MTU of a bond port.
clear port bit_error: clear the bit_error of the port.
remove port ipv4_address: remove the IPv4 address of a specified port. NOTE: After the IP address of an Ethernet host port is removed, the application sever that connects to the Ethernet host port cannot access the storage system.
remove port ipv6_address: remove the IPv6 address of a specified port. NOTE: After the IP address of an Ethernet host port is removed, the application sever that connects to the Ethernet host port cannot access the storage system.
add port ipv4_route: add an IPv4 route for a specific Ethernet port. If the IPv4 address of the storage system and that of an application server reside on different network segments, you can run this command to add a route to connect the storage system to application server.
add port ipv6_route: add an IPv6 route for a specific Ethernet port. If the IPv6 address of the storage system and that of a host reside on different network segments, you can run this command to add a route to connect the storage system to the host.
remove port ipv4_route: remove an IPv4 route configured for a port.
remove port ipv6_route: remove an IPv6 route configured for a port.
remove system management_ip: delete an IP address of a management network port.
create bond_port: create an Ethernet bond port. By binding multiple Ethernet ports, you can increase the data transmission bandwidth in parallel mode. The "create bond_port iscsi_port_id_list" command is replaced with the "create bond_port port_id_list" command.
change system management_ip: configure the IP address of a management port on new hardware. Both an IPv4 and IPv6 address can be configured, which is used by terminals to access the disk array.
change port roce: configure the properties for RoCE ports.
change port eth: configure the properties for Ethernet ports (including host ports and management network ports).
change port fc: modify the properties of a specific Fibre Channel port.
change port eth_snsd_switch: enable or disable the SNSD function of an Ethernet port.
change port ipv6_address: change the IPv6 address of a specific port.
change port ipv4_address: change the IPv4 address of a specific port.
remove net_plane ipv4_address: delete the IPv4 address of a network plane.
remove net_plane ipv4_gateway: delete the IPv4 gateway of a network plane.
remove net_plane ipv6_gateway: delete the IPv6 gateway of a network plane.
change enclosure id: modify the ID of a disk enclosure.
change enclosure location: change the location of an enclosure in a cabinet.
export running_data: export storage system configuration information to a .txt file. Such a .txt file can be read by users but cannot be used during configuration information import. If you need to know storage system configuration information, run this command.
export configuration_data: export the configuration file that resides in the storage system's memory. Such a configuration file stores important configuration information on the storage system's components and services. Export configuration data regularly and save it securely so that you can restore the configuration when the storage system fails.
change user_ssh_auth_info general: change the SSH authentication mode of a user.
change user_mode current_mode: switch a user view. This command is used when you want to switch from the user view to the developer or engineer view.
change ftds switch: set the main switch (excluding the workload switch), tracing switch, phase switch, latency switch, counting switch, workload collection switch, and workload feature extraction switch.
change dsm copy_num: modify the number of DSM copies.
change logical_port failover_group: configure failover groups for one or more logical ports.
remove logical_port ipv4_route: remove the IPv4 route from a logical port.
remove logical_port ipv6_route: remove the IPv6 route from a logical port.
change vlan general: change the VLAN maximum transmission unit.
remove failover_group eth_port: remove Ethernet ports from a customized failover group.
remove failover_group bond_port: remove specified bond ports from a customized failover group.
remove failover_group vlan_port: remove specified VLAN ports from a customized failover group.
delete failover_group general: delete a specified customized failover group.
